Zero (the default) routes echo output to the plain // write(1, …) syscall; non-zero (set only by the --web bridge) routes it to // elephc_web_write so the response body can be captured per request. Only the // low byte is used, but the 8-byte/align-3 house style keeps it word-aligned. // The symbol is mangled per-target so the bridge's `extern "C"` declaration // resolves to it on every platform (see emit_runtime_data_fixed docs).
